description: Adult vital-sign thresholds the briefing judges form_vitals readings against. OpenEMR stores weight in pounds, height in inches and temperature in Fahrenheit; blood pressure as two strings. `abnormal` bounds make a reading new since the prior visit a must-surface fact; `delta` thresholds make a change versus the most recent prior reading of the same vital a fact, so every routine visit is not noise. Adults only: the assembler emits no abnormal facts for a patient under 18. Every row is a clinical decision: cite the source and extend deliberately.

bp.source: 2017 ACC/AHA: stage 2 hypertension at 140/90 or above (decision B-1)

pulse.source: Adult resting heart rate outside 50-100 bpm

spo2.source: Resting oxygen saturation below 94 percent in adults

temperature_f.source: Fever at or above 100.4 F (38.0 C)

respiration.source: Adult resting respiratory rate above 20 per minute

bmi.source: WHO/CDC: underweight below 18.5, obesity at 30 or above

weight_lb.source: A change of 5 lb or 5 percent since the prior reading is worth a look

systolic.source: A systolic change of 20 mmHg since the prior reading

bmi.source: A BMI change of 2 since the prior reading
